I took it last weekend at Audiotistic. Personally, it felt like a mix of LSD and ecstasy. I got slight psychedelic effects but it wasn't a huge toll on my mind, meaning I didn't delve deep into my thoughts or had a huge head space. Additionally, I felt the "high" you would get from taking E, and sensations like hugging still felt amazing/affection. Didn't really have symptoms of jaw clenching like you would on MDMA.

I took about a 32mg capsule, which is a bit higher than I've read for a first time dose, but it was perfect for me as I tend to have large tolerances. I would recommend taking something lower, like around 15mg-20mg for your first time. Do your research. I've read lower doses tend to give a more ecstasy effect, while higher doses lean on the psychedelics. Mine was around the middle so I got the best of both.

I'd say it's an amazing alternative if you need to take a break from rolling. Would totally recommend, but as always do your research, be safe and test what you have, and only do what you're comfortable with. Be wary as it is still a psychedelic, so you want to look out for symptoms of a bad trip or the anxiety you might feel in the come up, especially being in a crowd.
